ranks: Reality Fracture (FRA, 2026-10-02): top 50% by EDHREC rank — its first 60 new cards (Commander-legal first printings), with Empower Jace built this batch (rule 701.71a)

blocked.name: Ajani Unrelenting
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability' — activates-ability only has who: "attached"; the rest of the card is expressible.

blocked.name: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom
blocked.why: The granted '{T}: Add {C}{C}' lasts 'until this card is cast from exile' and outlives the card leaving exile any other way (the ruling) — no such duration.

blocked.name: Chandra, Chill of Compliance
blocked.why: −X loyalty cost (Put X stun counters) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Sanctum Lurker
blocked.why: No exemption from the 704.5i 0-loyalty SBA, and no static granting a loyalty ability (+2) to planeswalkers you control.

blocked.name: Hall of Echoes
blocked.why: 'The legend rule doesn't apply to permanents you control this turn' is a player effect for the turn; a copy exception's legendRuleOff would end early if Hall stops being a copy or loses abilities, and would be copied by a Clone.

blocked.name: Draconic Visitor
blocked.why: would-create-token substitution exists only for creature tokens (creatureTokensInstead, Divine Visitation); none for artifact tokens.

blocked.name: Fatehold Charm
blocked.why: 'Target spell or creature': spell-or-permanent's one filter applies to both, so any spell plus only creature permanents can't be said (no zone clause in CardFilter).

blocked.name: Denzilore Fatehold
blocked.why: 'Whenever you scry or surveil' — only a surveil trigger (on: surveils) exists; nothing triggers on a scry.

blocked.name: Jace, Reality Sculptor
blocked.why: −3 'until your next turn, whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, it gets -5/-0' needs a delayed 'whenever' trigger lasting until your next turn; the +1 and the 0 are expressible.

blocked.name: Bloodline Recollector // Ancestral Craving
blocked.why: Prepare layout / 'becomes prepared' isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether
blocked.why: 'Enters prepared' and the prepare spell aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Jace's Machinations
blocked.why: 'Until end of turn, you may activate loyalty abilities of Jace planeswalkers you control … any time you could cast an instant' has no vocabulary.

blocked.name: Theorist's Sanctum
blocked.why: 'You may behold a Jace. If you don't, this land enters tapped' — behold (choose a Jace you control or reveal one from hand) isn't built; tappedUnlessRevealFromHand only covers the hand half.

blocked.name: Tam, the Possibility
blocked.why: 'Proliferate X times' needs a repeat, and X = 'the number of planeswalker types among planeswalkers you control' has no amount.

blocked.name: Way of the Paradox
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability' — activates-ability only has who: 'attached'.

blocked.name: Woodwork Prodigy // Soul Tether
blocked.why: Prepare layout / becoming prepared (a castable copy of the prepare spell in exile) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Countersculpt
blocked.why: Additional cost 'behold a Jace or pay {1}': behold isn't built.

blocked.name: Way of the Mind Sculptor
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability, if you removed two or more loyalty counters' — activates-ability is who: "attached" only, and the ability-activated event carries no loyalty cost.

blocked.name: Plan for All Outcomes
blocked.why: The target's owner chooses top or bottom of their library; put-on-library has a fixed position and each-player-may only reaches a target's controller, not its owner.

blocked.name: Garruk, Curse Breaker
blocked.why: −4 sets up an until-your-next-turn 'whenever one or more creatures attack one of your opponents, those creatures get +2/+2 and trample' — a per-defender attack batch acting on those attackers, held as a temporary trigger.

blocked.name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
blocked.why: 'That many plus one +1/+1 counters' — would-add-counter is a multiplier only.

blocked.name: Uldaros Theorix
blocked.why: Cast any number of the copies 'with total mana value 6 or less' — cast-now's copies/repeat have no running total-mana-value cap.
